findings.passage: “The right to own and bear arms is a fundamental constitutional right,” Verobish said. “Law-abiding citizens should not be required to obtain government permission before exercising that right while on the road.”
findings.note: Her statement in a House caucus release announcing her bill to end the concealed carry permit requirement for carrying a firearm in a vehicle.

Release says she introduced House Bill 2599 to remove the requirement that a person first obtain a concealed carry permit before carrying a firearm in a vehicle. Release date is the announcement date; the filing date was not checked on palegis.us.
